mods.name: LightUp
mods.description: Automatically place torches in dark areas around you

releases.notes:
Support for **Minecraft 26.2**.

## What changed

26.2 ships **unobfuscated** and Yarn has no builds for it, so the mod moves to the official Mojang names. Every replacement was checked against `server-26.2.jar`'s own class list rather than inferred.

Notable API changes handled:
- `Permission.Level` no longer exists — the gamemaster check is now `source.permissions().hasPermission(Permissions.COMMANDS_GAMEMASTER)`
- `PlayerInventory.count(Item)` has no equivalent, so a `countItems()` helper sums `getNonEquipmentItems()` directly
- light reads go through `getLightEngine().getLayerListener(LightLayer.BLOCK).getLightValue(pos)`
- `setBlock()` now requires explicit flags

No gameplay or command changes — `/lightup` behaves exactly as in 1.3.x.

## Requirements

| | |
|---|---|
| Minecraft | 26.2 |
| Fabric Loader | 0.19.3+ |
| Fabric API | 0.156.0+26.2 |
| Java | 25 |

## Verification

Tested on a dedicated Fabric 26.2 server — `/lightup 128` placed **1,298 torches across 5,046 grid positions in 132.3s** with no exceptions, average tick time 3.5 ms against the 50 ms budget.

releases.notes:
## LightUp v1.3.0

Automatically places torches in dark areas to prevent mob spawning.

### Features
- Grid-based algorithm for efficient torch placement
- Preview with stack breakdown before placing
- Survival mode (uses inventory) and OP mode (unlimited)
- Configurable radius 8-128 blocks
- Server-friendly (~10 torches/second)

### Commands
- `/lightup` - Preview with default radius (64 blocks)
- `/lightup <radius>` - Preview with custom radius
- `/lightup stop` - Stop current task
- `/lightup help` - Show commands

### Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader 0.18.4+
- Fabric API 0.140.2+
